title: memo: skip re-renders with the same props

slides.say: Normally a component re-renders whenever its parent does. Memo changes that.
Wrap it in memo. When the parent re-renders, React skips Greeting if its props are the same as last time.

slides.text: It still re-renders when its own state or a context it reads changes.
slides.say: Memo only looks at props. Greeting still re-renders if its own state changes, or a context it uses changes.

slides.text: Performance only. If code breaks without memo, fix the real bug first.
slides.say: Treat memo as a performance optimization only. If your code does not work without it, fix the underlying problem first.
